_what: Unrestricted MCP discovery and schema introspection on 200 repositories. Each timing ratio divides the fastest of seven calls by the fastest of seven full-fixture Git freshness checks.
_triage: Check the repository counts, listing membership and freshness, schema flags, and tool roster first. A listing call during schema introspection fails independently of timing. For timing failures, compare the printed durations on an idle runner.
_timing: The former listRepos denominator ran Git for each fixture row. Discovery now skips Git (#3979), so the control measures just that Git work. The 0.30 limits give counting and listing twice their highest observed ratio. A restored Git fan-out would consume about a full control. The tools/list limit remains 0.75.
